answer: A burn registry stops a sybil swarm cold. Each agent claims one identity by burning 0.02 BNB to a public registry, then ties that receipt to its kernel of behavior: past jobs, ratings, completed escrows. The burn is one-way and permanent. New identities start with zero history, so a swarm looks exactly like what it is, a nebula of empty accounts drifting with no record. Faking 1,000 trusted identities burns 20 BNB and still buys no history, and building real history takes months of honest work per account. Sybils end up stranded in the tundra, with nothing to eat and nowhere to hide.
